[[File:Jump AG126.png|thumb|250px|Jump]]
(Japanese: '''ジャンプ''' ''Jump'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG126|Saved by the Beldum]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who competed in the preliminary rounds of the [[Ever Grande Conference]]. He was not given an official name in the English [[dub]].

During the [[Hoenn League]] {{pkmn|League Conference|championship competition}}, Jump faced off against [[Morrison]]. He had an advantage since [[Morrison's Beldum]] only knew {{m|Take Down}} and he was constantly commanding his Electabuzz to use {{m|Protect}} to negate all [[damage]].

Just when it looked like Jump was going to be the victor, Morrison's {{p|Beldum}} [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Metang}} and defeated Electabuzz using a combination of {{m|Confusion}} and Take Down. Jump's loss meant that he was out of the tournament.
